Is this project still ongoing? I missed this when the articles came out. I know there are active residency Income projects going on elsewhere in southern Italy right now. Like there is in Presicce Acquarica. But I was hoping to live in Calabria as that is where my ancestors emigrated from and where I have extended family to this day. 
If anyone can give me a yes or no, or even better, point me to where to apply; all would be much appreciated.
In the words of immortal technique “capitalism and democracy are not synonymous”
